question: The Indian Air Force was established on:
solution:
Correct answer is__** 8 October 1932.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Air Force was officially accepted on **8 October 1932**.
 
• **The Indian Air Force** arise and on 1st April 1954 **Air Marshal Subroto Mukherjee**, one of the founding members of the Air Force took over as the **first Indian Chief of Air Staff.**
 
• The Indian Air Force is the **air arm of the Indian Armed Forces.** 
 
• Its primary mission is to** fix Indian airspace** and to conduct aerial warfare during armed dispute.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61cbaa50d1a9642a682372ff6e8b6ae4703ec170ed7364b5dc0c2b76a99f68aa.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Indian Army** was setup in **1895** along the side of the long accepted presidency armies of the East India Company, which too were absorbed into it in 1903.
 
• **The Royal Indian Navy** was formally inaugurated on **2 October 1934**, at Bombay.​ 
 
• Its ships carried the **prefix HMIS, **for His Majesty's Indian Ship.
